subject: Privatelink / VPC connectivity feasibility for CloudBridge listing + demo plan
messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@cloudbridge.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 07:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick question on PrivateLink / VPC for AWS listing

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We’re progressing toward an AWS Marketplace listing and the AWS partner team flagged network connectivity: they want to know whether Redwood can support PrivateLink or an equivalent VPC endpoint pattern for co-sell customers (our customers are asking for no-internet egress to your inference endpoints).

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports PrivateLink or a supported VPC endpoint configuration today (certified path or engineering work required)?
- If not supported, what’s a realistic engineering timeline and dependencies for adding it?

I attached our current architecture diagram and a short security summary so you have context (cloudbridge-arch-diagram.png, cloudbridge-security-summary.pdf). We’d also like to schedule a short technical demo with your infra/edge team next week to go over traffic patterns and cert/key exchange.

Appreciate a high-level answer so I can pass to AWS partner engineering.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Miller
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge.ai
(sarah.miller@cloudbridge.ai)

Attachment: cloudbridge-security-summary.pdf (application/pdf, 220 KB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick question on PrivateLink / VPC for AWS listing

Hi Sarah — thanks for the context and the attachments. Short answer: we do not today offer a managed AWS PrivateLink endpoint (that is, a provider-owned interface endpoint) as a turnkey Marketplace integration, but we do support customer VPC-to-VPC connectivity patterns that meet the "no public egress" requirement via a supported set of options. High-level options:

1) Customer-managed VPC peering / Transit Gateway + VPC routing to a Private subnet where our dedicated infra is placed (requires Dedicated or Private deployment).
2) PrivateLink-like pattern using a managed Network Load Balancer and interface endpoints on the customer side — we have an engineering path for this but it requires work on our side to offer as a fully managed Marketplace listing feature.
3) For hosted customers, we can offer an IP allowlist + TLS mutual auth as an interim compliance approach (not full private connectivity).

Given the Marketplace co-sell ask, option (2) is probably the ideal long-term solution. I’ve looped in Olga (marketplace/security) and Ben (partner GTM) to scope effort and commercialization implications.

Proposed next step: 30-min technical sync Tues 12/1 09:30 PT (I’ll send a calendar invite once I hear back). In that call we can do a short demo, confirm requirement details, and map out an engineering/launch timeline.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

Attachment: none

Olga / Ben — forwarding Sarah’s note. TL;DR: CloudBridge wants PrivateLink-style connectivity for AWS Marketplace co-sell. They’re early-stage but have enterprise customers, and AWS partner eng is pushing this as a gating requirement for a co-sell ready listing.

Questions for you both (quick):

- Ben: Commercially, if we need to offer Dedicated/Private deployments to enable VPC peering or PrivateLink, what is the minimal packaging and pricing language we should propose to CloudBridge? Also any marketplace listing language we should prep (co-sell entitlements, free trial credits)?

I think we can get a quick sync on Tues with Sarah and AWS — can you both make 09:30 PT on 2026-12-01? If not, propose alternatives.

Connor

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0500

Connor / Ben — quick answers:

Security evidence (minimum):
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (we can provide redacted sections)
- Network architecture diagram showing isolation for dedicated/private infra (I can pull a template)
- TLS mutual-auth and key rotation process doc (we have this)
- Pen test summary (top-level)

PrivateLink playbook: we don’t have a turnkey PrivateLink consumer/provider template published, but we have notes from a past partner (internal doc id in Drive). Engineering effort estimate for building a managed PrivateLink offering: 6–10 sprints (depends on infra prioritization) — we can scope MVP to support interface endpoint provisioning + NLB config + routing automation.

Commercials: Ben: suggest we prepare a Dedicated SKU add-on for marketplace listings (monthly committed capacity + onboarding fee). Also propose a co-sell trial offer (30 days free up to X tokens) to reduce friction for initial customers — could be promo SKU on the listing.

I’ll prep the minimal evidence packet and share the Drive link before the Tue call.

Olga
Olga Petrov
VP, Marketplace Security & Compliance
olga_petrov@redwood.com
